onboarding.title: Private messaging
onboarding.subtitle: End-to-end encrypted. No phone number. Minimal, temporary metadata.

conversationList.selfConversationError: You can't start a conversation with yourself.
conversationList.untrustedIdentityError: {{peerId}}'s security key changed since last time (they probably reinstalled the app). Confirm the other person's identity before trying again.
conversationList.blockedChannelError: This conversation can't be started — one of you has blocked the other.
conversationList.emptyState: No conversations yet. Enter someone's user_id above to start — messages here are end-to-end encrypted.
conversationList.renameHint: Only you see this name — it stays on this phone and is never sent to the server.
conversationList.deleteConversationBody: You leave the conversation and delete its history from this phone. The other person can no longer message you here. This is not the same as blocking — either of you can start a new conversation later.
conversationList.deleteConversationFailed: Could not leave the conversation. Please try again.
conversationList.muteFailed: Could not change notifications for this conversation. Try again.
conversationList.backupPromptBody: If you lose this phone, your account and your contacts go with it — there is no way to restore them, not even by us. The backup takes a minute.

conversation.emptyState: No messages in this conversation yet.
conversation.blockConfirmMessage: You won't be able to exchange messages with {{peerId}} anymore. You can unblock them later in Settings > Blocked.
conversation.securityWarningDecrypt: {{peerId}}'s security key changed since your last conversation. This message wasn't decrypted — confirm with the other person before continuing.
conversation.securityWarningSend: {{peerId}}'s security key changed since your last conversation. The message wasn't sent — confirm with the other person before continuing.
conversation.reportEmailBody:
I want to report the user with user_id: {{peerId}}

Describe what happened here (you can paste the message text in question):
conversation.reportGroupEmailBody:
I want to report a group (channel id: {{channelId}})

Describe what happened here (you can paste the message in question):
conversation.deleteMessageBody: The message is deleted from the server and from this phone. If the other person has the app open it disappears from theirs too — but if they are offline, their copy may remain. Nothing prevents a screenshot.
conversation.deleteFailed: Could not delete the message from the server. It was removed from this phone.
conversation.sendFailed: Could not send. Check your connection and try again — your text is still here.
conversation.blockFailed: Couldn't block. Check your connection and try again.
conversation.leaveGroupBody: You stop receiving messages from this group and its history is deleted from this phone. The group carries on for everyone else — only its owner can add you back.
conversation.leaveGroupFailed: Could not leave the group. Check your connection and try again.
conversation.editingHint: The other person will see it was edited.
conversation.editFailed: The edit didn't reach the other person. Try again.
conversation.reactionFailed: The reaction didn't reach the other person.
conversation.recordingInterrupted: The phone interrupted the recording (a call, or the screen locking) and it was not sent. You can record again.
conversation.microphoneDenied: Seixo needs microphone access to record.
conversation.blockMemberBody: You stop receiving this person's messages — in this group and in any conversation. They stay in the group and are not told. Messages you already received stay here. You can unblock in Settings > Blocked.
conversation.blockMemberDone: Member blocked. Their messages will no longer appear.
conversation.blockMemberFailed: Could not block. Check your connection and try again.
conversation.groupOwnerNote: Only whoever created the group can add or remove people.
conversation.groupNoHistoryNote: Anyone joining now cannot see earlier messages — they were encrypted with keys that person does not have.
conversation.emptyGroupNotice: This group has nobody in it yet. Tap Members to add people — messages can only be sent after that.
conversation.deleteGroupBody: The group and its messages disappear from the server for everyone. Messages each person already received stay on their phone until their timer removes them — this cannot reach those.
conversation.groupNameFailed: The name didn't reach the other members.
conversation.oneOffTtlHint: Applies to the next message only. The conversation keeps its own timer.
conversation.imagePickFailed: Could not open the camera or the library.
conversation.imagePrepareFailed: Could not prepare the image. Nothing was sent.
conversation.imageMetadataRefused: This image still carried photo data (such as its location) after being cleaned, so it was not sent.
conversation.cameraDenied: Without camera access, a photo cannot be taken.

settings.deleteConfirmMessage: This deletes your identity and all associated data on the server (keys, prekeys, started conversations, blocks) and on this device. This can't be undone.

sounds.hint: The sound plays when a notification arrives. The sounds ship inside the app — the server never sends audio, only the name of the one you chose. If the phone is on silent, iOS plays none.
sounds.saveFailed: Your choice is saved on this phone, but the server could not be told. It will be sent next time you open the app.

settings.appLockLabel: Require Face ID to open the app
settings.appLockHint: When on, Seixo asks for Face ID (or your device passcode) every time you come back to it. Messages still arrive while it's locked.
settings.appLockUnavailable: This device has no Face ID, Touch ID or passcode set, so there is nothing for Seixo to check against.
settings.backupHint: Saves your identity to an encrypted file, so you can get back into the same account on another phone. Messages are not included.
settings.showPreviewsHint: In the conversation list, under each name. Turn it off if you don't want someone looking at your screen to see it.
settings.serverFootprintHint: See, right now, everything that exists about you on the server.

screenshotWarning.title: Screenshot
screenshotWarning.message: You took a screenshot. Remember conversations here are private — avoid sharing them.

scanQr.hint: Point the camera at the other person's QR code.
scanQr.permissionDenied: Camera access is needed to scan QR codes.
scanQr.permissionBlocked: Camera access is off. To scan QR codes, turn it on in iPhone Settings, under Seixo.

appLock.lockedBody: Use Face ID or your device passcode to open your conversations.
appLock.failedBody: Couldn't confirm it's you. Try again.

notifications.title: Seixo
notifications.groupBody: You were added to a group.

safetyNumber.title: Safety number
safetyNumber.explanation: Compare this code with the other person — in person, by call, or any way other than this app. If it matches on both phones, nobody is in the middle reading you.
safetyNumber.resetWarning: This person's security key changed. That happens when they reinstall the app — but it is also what you would see if someone were impersonating them. Only continue if you have confirmed the code above with them by other means.

backup.intro: The backup holds who you are: your ID and your key. On a new phone your contacts keep talking to you without having to verify you again. Messages are not included — they still disappear on the timer you chose.
backup.credentialsError: The account did not accept its recovery credentials, so this backup would not let you back in. Nothing was saved.
backup.phraseWarning: Without these words the file cannot be opened, and there is no way to recover them. Do not keep them in the same place as the file.
backup.phraseCopiedMessage: The words are on the clipboard. Paste them somewhere safe, then clear the clipboard.
backup.fileHint: You choose where it goes: Files, iCloud, AirDrop to your computer. The file is useless to anyone without the 12 words.
backup.footnote: None of this is kept on our server. We hold no copies and cannot recover yours if you lose it.
backup.expiryWarning: The account still deletes itself after 6 months without being opened, and the backup stops working with it. Opening the app now and then is enough to prevent that.

restore.intro: Getting back into the same account takes both parts: the file and the 12 words.
restore.phrasePlaceholder: the twelve words, separated by spaces
restore.phraseInvalid: These words are not a valid phrase. Check whether one is misspelled.
restore.footnote: Old messages do not come back — they were never in the backup. Conversations start again, with the same ID and the same safety number.
restore.accountGone: The words are right and the file opened, but this account no longer exists. It was most likely deleted after 6 months without use. You can create a new identity, but the old ID does not come back.

terms.title: Before you start
terms.intro: Seixo is for private conversations between people who know each other. To use it, you agree to these rules:
terms.rule1: Zero tolerance for illegal content, child sexual abuse, harassment, threats, hate speech, spam and fraud.
terms.rule2: Nobody can read your messages, not even us. That is why you can block and report anyone, and we review reports.
terms.rule3: We may delete accounts that break these rules.
terms.rule4: You are responsible for what you send. Disappearing messages do not stop someone taking a screenshot.
terms.rule5: You must be at least 13, or the minimum age required in your country.

permissions.microphoneBlockedBody: You turned off microphone access. To record voice messages, turn it on in iPhone Settings, under Seixo.
permissions.cameraBlockedBody: You declined camera access. To take photos, turn it on in the phone’s Settings. Choosing from the library still works without it.

share.intro: Choose a conversation. The content goes into the text box and is only sent when you press send.
share.empty: You have no conversations yet. Start one and share again.

serverFootprint.intro: This is everything that exists about you in the database, read just now. None of it is stored on the phone: close this and come back, and it is asked for again.
serverFootprint.lastUseHint: The day only. The time is never stored.
serverFootprint.keysHint: Signed + one-time, so others can start a conversation with you.
serverFootprint.displayNameHint: Published by you and unreadable to the server.
serverFootprint.noConversations: The server holds no conversations of yours.
serverFootprint.absentList: The content of messages · who sent each message in a one-to-one conversation · the names you gave your contacts · the names of groups
serverFootprint.hostingNote: This is the database. Before a request reaches it, the hosting provider's entry layer records it and keeps, for 24 hours, your IP, the approximate city and postal code, your internet provider and, in most cases, your account id. We do not control it and cannot delete it sooner. It is explained in the privacy policy.
